title: migrate plan plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/agent/plan to the v2 stage↔engine contract: v2 fields in plan.json on every exit path, intake_goal input replacing goal_string, disposition vocabulary, rc ∈ {0,1}, valid_verdicts declared, router budgets in manifest, and the leaf path's rc=10 branch in runner.sh deleted.

steps.description: Write failing tests covering all v2 acceptance criteria: (a) plan.json has result_contract:2, verdict=pass, disposition=complete, non-empty reason on success path; (b) plan.json has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=unusable on error path (invalid_plan_response); (c) plan.json has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=out_of_turns on scope_too_large path; (d) manifest declares valid_verdicts: [pass, error]; (e) router config has timeout_s and max_turns keys; (f) grep assert plugin.sh contains no ZBUILD_GOAL reference; (g) manifest declares intake_goal input with required:true and no source:; (h) runner_read_stage_verdict on a success plan.json returns pass with no contract_violation. Run and confirm RED on each new assertion.

Update manifest.yaml: (1) add result_contract: 2 under provides alongside existing role/events; (2) replace valid_verdicts: [] with [pass, error]; (3) add timeout_s: 300 and max_turns: 45 to config.router; (4) replace goal_string input (source: external, required: false) with id: intake_goal, required: true (no source, no type — name-matched); (5) retries: 1 and retry_on_exhaustion: 1 stay; PR records why: resume-via-checkpoint makes retry-on-exhaustion safe and the manifest comments already explain the justification.

Update plugin.sh with five changes: (1) Add _plan_write_result helper (~18 lines) that writes a minimal {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason} JSON to a given path using atomic_write — used by failure paths that have no plan.json yet. (2) Read scope_manifest from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS via jq .scope_manifest, falling back to constructed path; replace the hardcoded assignment at line 111. (3) Replace the ZBUILD_GOAL + intake.md block (lines 115–124) with reading intake_goal path from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS via jq .intake_goal and cat-ing the file; if missing or empty, call _plan_write_result to a best-effort path and return 1. (4) Wire _plan_write_result on failure exits: no-state-file path (~line 105, use ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR env); no-goal path (~line 123, use artifacts_dir); scope_too_large path (~line 849, use output_plan_json, disposition=out_of_turns, return 1 not 10); error path (~line 861, use output_plan_json, disposition=unusable). (5) On success path: before atomic_write of plan.json, merge v2 fields into plan_json via jq: result_contract:2, verdict:pass, disposition:complete, reason dynamically incorporating step count.

Delete the leaf path rc=10 branch from runner.sh: remove the block from 'if [[ $_rc -eq 10 ]]; then' through its closing 'fi' (lines 3506–3522, approximately 17 lines). This branch was the only consumer of plan's rc=10 signal; under v2 plan returns rc=1 with disposition=out_of_turns instead, and the generic non-zero handler below applies.

Run npm test to confirm all new tests from step-1 go green and no existing tests regressed. If any existing assertion references return 2 or rc=10 from plan, repair the assertion to match the new rc=1 contract. plan-test.sh must stay under 1000 lines total.

notes:
1. RESULT FILE: plan.json is the one v2 result file. The Direction explicitly forbids a second file (plan-result.json). On success, v2 fields are merged into the plan content JSON before atomic_write. On failure, a minimal {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason} is written to the plan.json path — the engine verdict reader (verdict.sh:391-414) only requires those four fields to be non-empty strings and does not validate the surrounding plan schema.

2. INTAKE_GOAL vs ZBUILD_GOAL: the manifest replaces goal_string (source: external) with intake_goal (required: true, name-matched). Plugin reads the artifact path from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS just as it reads scope_manifest. Intake writes intake.md in both --goal and --issue runs, so the path is always available under v2 dispatch. The existing ZBUILD_GOAL fallback is removed entirely — the acceptance criterion requires no ZBUILD_GOAL reference in plugin.sh.

3. RC=10 DELETION SCOPE: the Direction says 'the only runner change in scope is deleting the leaf path's rc=10 branch'. There are three rc=10 branches in runner.sh (lines ~3215, ~3508, ~3913). Only the leaf path (lines 3506–3522) is in scope. The cycle-loop branch (~3215) and other branch (~3913) are untouched — they belong to the cycle runner path which is not a leaf.

4. ROUTER KNOBS: retries:1 and retry_on_exhaustion:1 are NOT removed. The issue says 'each knob either goes or the PR records why it still has to stay'. The existing manifest comments (lines 35–55) already document precisely why both are justified (checkpoint-based resume makes retries safe; measured data from runs 20260817*). The PR description must cite those comments.

5. VALID VERDICTS: pass (plan produced) and error (scope_too_large, invalid/empty/schema failure, missing input). disposition=out_of_turns is used for scope_too_large with verdict=error, consistent with ADR-054 §6a. disposition=unusable for other errors. disposition=complete for success.

6. EARLY EXIT AT LINE 105: artifacts_dir is not yet defined. Use ${ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR:-} env var to construct the plan.json path; skip writing the v2 result if the env var is unset (the engine cannot read it anyway without an artifact dir).

7. PARITY GOLDEN IMPACT: plan.json gains new fields (result_contract, verdict, disposition, reason). Any parity golden that snapshots plan.json content will need updating. The issue says parity goldens must be unchanged — this tension must be resolved by confirming whether parity goldens snapshot plan.json field-for-field or only check specific fields. If goldens must update, that is scope creep; note in PR if encountered.

8. runner_read_stage_verdict TEST: this tests that the engine's verdict reader accepts a success plan.json. The test constructs a synthetic plan.json with all required v2 fields plus a representative plan payload, calls runner_read_stage_verdict, and asserts verdict=pass and no contract_violation variable set.

9. CLEANUP HOOK: plan holds no live resources. cleanup hook remains absent — no stub needed.
